The GitHub link found was a cited smolagents repository. Aggregate/per-seed tables alone do not supply the required stable paired episode outcomes. This is not a claim that no dataset exists anywhere.

eligibility.selection_basis: First historical snapshot in the already recorded timestamp-based version rule. It supplies a manifest, per-episode policy/repeat outcome schema, and author objective label sources. Full-population quantities remain conditional on actual completeness and label compatibility.

groups.excluded_from_outcome_inspection: Other episode IDs, all rep=2/3 outcome values, and all other rungs. Full files are hashed and identity metadata may be checked; their outcome values are not analyzed.
groups.scope: Same-operator retrospective analysis of author-generated outcomes; no new model calls, retraining, regrading, independent evaluator or O behavioral measurement.
groups.unit_of_analysis: episode_id, with one outcome per selected policy

next_action: After immutable protocol verification, inspect the selected released outcome columns, produce the bounded result and one next experiment recommendation, refresh non-blocking readiness, perform Execute Local Learn, and continue the native lifecycle.
outcome_rules: Keep exactly one accounting row for every selected episode ID, including all missing, duplicate, malformed, unmatched and conflicting records. Do not replace an ID or select another repeat after viewing outcomes.
Accept only one CSV row per selected episode/rung/rep. Any duplicate selected key is invalid for that key, even if the rows agree. Do not choose a favorable or last duplicate.
Parse released booleans strictly as True or False. Use now_correct from the independent author labeler; now_correct_checks_parser is diagnostic only. Do not use checks or alarm rates as task success.

Primary paired repair comparisons require unique none/resample/located rep1 rows, consistent was_correct across these rows, none.now_correct equal to that baseline, checks_flag_before consistency, and equal resample/located steps_before and resumed_from. Record each failure without silently fixing source data.

The baseline label table describes its own author task labels: healthy=true; arithmetic_error,hallucinated,incomplete,other=false. Compare its label with the verification table label and each available repair label/was_correct; retain all disagreements. Report source-specific baseline prevalence, but do not join inconsistent grade definitions into one population effect.

No repair row does not imply success, zero harm, or an unflagged episode. The verification table records only total_consistency and required_coverage; it is not accepted as complete verify.failed coverage. A missing policy outcome remains UNKNOWN.

Population p=F/N is supported only with a complete, unique, recognized and internally compatible baseline definition. For each policy, r=C/F, d=B/S and delta=(C-B)/N=p*r-(1-p)*d require compatible baseline and paired outcomes for the corresponding denominator. Zero denominators yield UNKNOWN, not zero.

Separately report counts, success rate, recovery C/F, disruption B/S and net change on the complete paired observed subset; label every such denominator explicitly. Never extrapolate it to all 100 selected or all 120 released episodes.

If baseline is compatible but policy outcomes are missing, report worst-case finite-sample bounds: unknown failures may recover or remain failed and unknown successes may break or remain successful. Bounds are not imputed point estimates. If baseline compatibility fails, do not compute combined population bounds.

For supported proportions report Wilson 95 percent intervals with z=1.959963984540054. The one primary policy contrast is located versus resample on the matched observed subset, using an exact two-sided binomial McNemar calculation on discordant pairs. No repeat pooling and no other policy significance search.

Confidence intervals are model-based summaries for this fixed, nonrandom released slice. They do not prove transfer, independent replication, absence of future harm, or a causal effect in O. Retain source configuration drift and paper-to-current-README significance differences.

pre_unblinding_gate.required: Publish this exact protocol and source/identity metadata to an immutable O commit on a uniquely named branch; read back each intended blob at that commit before inspecting or computing any selected outcomes. Persist the publication receipt, then run a separate deterministic analyzer.

selected_dataset.selection: First 100 unique stable episode IDs in UTF-8 bytewise order from the pinned manifest, without outcome filtering. Duplicate manifest IDs are an integrity failure, never silently resolved.
